name: received_at
description: When sGTM received the event, in UTC. The table is partitioned on it.

name: reason
description: Why the event was rejected, e.g. an unknown event_name or a property of the wrong type.

name: source
description: The path the event arrived on: frontend (the GA4 client), backend (the custom client), or unknown.

name: event_id
description: The event's event_id, when it could be read. Not trusted: it may not be a UUID.

name: payload
description: The raw event as received, cut to a fixed length. Can hold anything a sender posted.
